_note: All gameplay numbers live here. Speeds are world units/s, ranges world units, reload seconds. power = casualties per man per volley at point blank.

deploy._note: Deployment phase (local battles): a side may place its regiments anywhere within `r` units of where any of its starting regiments stands

difficulty._note: Easy / Normal / Hard: the bot's regiments (start, reinforcements, reserves) at this share of their scenario strength

stun._note: Foot or guns (not in square or a farm) hit by a cavalry charge are stunned for `time` s x the slope factor x (horse men / foot men, clamped to `size`) x `charge` with the Charge special: they cannot fire, move or change formation, and fight at `melee` x their usual rate

shaken._note: Fire rattles what it hits: `k` s per 100% of the regiment lost in one blow (so ~4 s for a 10% bite), + flank[aspect] s on a flank or rear hit, + up to `routers` s when broken men run through; capped at `max`. Shaken: reload takes `reload` x as long, fire does `fire` x, no formation changes (it can still move)

falter._note: A charging regiment (horse on an attack, or a bayonet charge) that loses `share` or more of its men to one volley or round loses its momentum: the charge bonus ends, a bayonet charge stalls into a firefight, and for `time` s its impact shocks and stuns at `impact` x

screen._note: Fire at a regiment through its own skirmishers' screen does `fire` x damage; skirmishers firing at a battery do `guns` x (they pick off the crews)

plough._note: Round shot that hits carries on up to `reach` units behind its target and strikes the next regiment of that side in its path for `carry` x the casualties

breakoff._note: Horse ordered away from its foe in a melee strikes no blows while it gets clear; the foe hits it at `hit` x the usual rate, with no flank or rear bonus

hold._note: posted: foot or guns standing still for `after` seconds take `fire` x casualties and `morale` x morale loss, and get +`shock` on the charge morale test

holdFire._note: Hold fire stance (line, guard, guns): no fire until a foe is within `range` x the regiment's range (an ordered target excepted); the first volley after `loaded` s without firing does `first` x damage (not on top of the Volley special)

night._note: Darkness from the scenario clock: 0 at `dusk`, 1 at `dark` (hours); sight (fog of war, and so what the bot sees) x (1 - dark x `sight`), fire x (1 - dark x `fire`)

march._note: 'March in column' (a player setting): a line ordered farther than `dist` forms column for the march and forms line again on arrival, or as soon as a foe it can see is within musket range

fallback._note: Foot or horse ordered to a point behind it (over 120 degrees off its facing) and nearer than `dist` steps back facing the enemy, without wheeling, at `speed` x its pace

doubleTime._note: Double time (double right-click): marches at `speed` x, tiring at fatigue.run, until it arrives

courier._note: Courier orders (a player setting): an order to a regiment farther than `free` from its nearest general (the entry point once they have all fallen) arrives after (distance - free) / `speed` s; aids, reserves, auto-square and replenishing are not delayed

turn._note: Wheel rates in radians/s by formation (foot) or arm; slack = the most a unit may be off its heading and still step off (else it wheels in place first); arc = the most a target may be off the facing and still be fired on.

separation._note: Regiments that overlap without being locked in melee are pushed apart: at most `max` units/s in total, shared by weight (the lighter one gives way), so a squadron cannot shove a whole line faster than it can walk. turn.engage is the rate in rad/s at which a regiment wheels to face the foe that has hit it.

limber._note: Seconds for a battery to unlimber after it halts (down) and to limber up before it can move (up).

passLines._note: seconds a regiment held up by friendly ranks (after trying to step round either side) waits before filing through them

morale._note: cap: share of max morale lost at zero strength (the ceiling falls with casualties); regen: recovery per s once quiet s without losses; rally: routed recovery per s past rallyDistance (x auraRally near the commander).

fatigue._note: fat 0..1. march: gain per s on the move by formation/arm; run: gain per s at a charge or sprint; fight: per s in melee; rest: loss per s standing out of melee; blown: spike when a cavalry charge strikes home. Effects at fat 1: slow = speed lost, fire/melee = damage lost, regen = morale recovery lost.

bayonet._note: Infantry bayonet charge: runs (sprint pace) inside runDist of the target, the morale test at testDist; melee x while charging; grind = morale-loss multiplier for foot-vs-foot melee; recoil = distance a thrown-back charger falls back.

shock._note: Morale test when charged: steadiness = morale/max - loss*(share of men lost) - fat*fatigue + square/garrison - flank[aspect] - size*(charger men/own men - 1, 0..1) - fresh*(own fat - charger fat, >=0) + vet*rank + aura - cav (foot not in square vs horse) +- spread/2; holds at >= pass.

terrain._note: Movement multipliers by arm; river = deep water (fords use their own map value); road = bonus for columns, guns, horse not in melee; downhill = max downhill bonus; charge = melee/shock gain per unit of ground fall per unit of run (clamped +-30%); gunReach = artillery range gain per unit of height over the target (max x1.3).
